definitions.explanation: The color of gold; a bright yellow metallic color associated with gold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕日|ゆうひ}→夕日：04080_yuuhi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金色|きんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まった→染まる：04254_somaru⟧。
examples.english: The sky was dyed golden by the setting sun.

examples.japanese: {金色|きんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There was a foreigner with golden hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{銀杏|いちょう}→銀杏：04379_ichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金色|きんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{色|いろ}づく→色づく：10074_irozuku⟧。
examples.english: In autumn, ginkgo trees turn golden.

notes:
{金色|きんいろ} is the color of gold — a bright, metallic yellow. Used both literally and for describing golden hues in nature.

PRONUNCIATION:
- {金色|きんいろ}: standard, everyday reading
- {金色|こんじき}: literary/poetic reading (seen in classical texts and proper names)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {金色|きんいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: golden ~
- {金色|きんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine golden
- {金色|きんいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed/tinged golden

RELATED COLORS:
- ⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧: silver
- ⟦{黄金色|こがねいろ}→黄金色：19037_koganeiro⟧: golden (more literary, warm tone)
- ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧: gold (the metal or color as a standalone word)

USAGE:
Often used to describe autumn foliage (⟦{銀杏|いちょう}→銀杏：04379_ichou⟧ ginkgo trees turning gold), sunsets, and hair color.
